messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: auth-error spike detected on /v1/session.login — 401s increased ~18x in us-east-1 starting 2026-03-15T01:12:00Z. Pattern: many identical usernames, rapid attempts from a small set of IP blocks. Tagging oncall.
Sam W: oncall here, I see the alert, paging SRE. Looks like impact to API login path only.
Priya K: confirmed in logs, 401s then 429s cascade. UA strings show 'python-requests' variants and missing csrf cookie in some flows. Might be credential-probing.
Evan L: ok probable credential probing. Recommend: 1) temporary per-IP ratelimit at 10 r/min on /v1/session.login 2) WAF rule to block obvious probe IP ranges and ASN 46606 3) reduce anon-login quota from 1000/min to 20/min for 30m.
Security Ops: adding: apply 401-to-429 shaping for suspicious IPs, enable challenge page for web UI flows. For API flows, prefer returning 429 to slow attackers.
Oncall SRE: starting mitigations now. Running command to add temporary rate limit rule:
```
# console snippet (internal)
apply_rate_limit --path /v1/session.login --mode per_ip --limit 10/m --duration 30m --reason "live credential probe"
```
Oncall SRE: WAF rule pushed to block 192.0.2.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24 (high prob bots).
Ops Bot: WAF rule push queued: ID wf-30721. Applied to us-east-1 fleet.
Sam W: monitoring metrics -> 1m after change 401s down 60% but 429s up on same path. Good, probe slowed. Need to confirm real customers not impacted.
Alex P: any paying customers hitting login failures now? We should notify 2 enterprise customers if they see auth errors.
Maya C: CS reports two customers (org-47, org-108) seeing increased login errors via support. Opening secure contact channel. Will coordinate status page update if needed.
Priya K: rolling a feature-flag to disable passwordless API sign-in for anonymous clients (flag: disable_api_pwdless_anon) for 15m as a canary.
Oncall SRE: flag toggle command output:
```
featureflags toggle disable_api_pwdless_anon --env prod --on --actor oncall --note "mitigate probe"
=> success: flag active in 5/6 clusters, rolling to remaining cluster
```
Evan L: good. Also suggest lowering global burst quota for token create route to prevent fanout.
Security Ops: starting a passive block for reqs matching regex of repeated username patterns, will escalate to active block if no drop in noise.
Oncall SRE: implementing passive block rule now.
Sam W: observed behavior: attackers pivoted to trying smaller credential sets per IP once IP limits applied. Need to watch for distributed proxy farms.
Incident Bot: NOTE: correlated spike also hitting embed endpoints but much lower rate. No evidence of data exfil.
Alex P: can we throttle login attempts per account id? If attackers are distributed, per-account throttles reduce impact on a single user being hammered.
Priya K: implemented per-account lockout after 5 failed attempts in 10m for accounts with low recent activity.
Oncall SRE: lockout rule deployed. Watchlist created for accounts with >5 failures in 1h.
Ops Bot: change events: rate-limit rule wf-rl-441 created, feature-flag toggle logged ff-903, per-account lockout rule lc-77 created. All changes tagged with incident:INC-2026-142.
Maya C: CS update: contacting affected customers privately. Sending status note: "We are mitigating an automated login probe. Temporary throttling may affect some API calls. We're monitoring and will minimize customer disruption."
Evan L: plan for next 30m: keep current rate limits, monitor 5m windows, if probe persists escalate to WAF active challenge (captcha) for web flows and 403 block for API from repeat offenders.
Sam W: current impact: 2 enterprise customers reporting errors, majority of users unaffected; important to keep ticket short and hand off to security ops for longer investigation.
Security Ops: will take lead on investigation post-mitigation. Collecting IPs, UA strings, attack patterns.
Oncall SRE: preparing handoff notes for next oncall: summary of actions, rules added, IDs and rollback commands. Handoff at 03:00 UTC.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-142 created. Summary: automated credential probing against /v1/session.login, mitigations applied (per-ip rate-limits, WAF blocks, per-account lockouts, feature-flag for anonymous pwdless disabled). Customer impact: limited (2 customers reported), monitoring continues.
Sam W: thanks team — handing off to Security Ops and next oncall. Will update channel if anything changes. :thumbsup:
Security Ops: taking ownership for investigation, will open forensic ticket and contact abuse teams for IP takedowns if needed.
Incident Bot: closing note for thread: keep this thread for live mitigations only; investigation moved to sec-investigations-292 channel."
